hooks.name: Assert.IQ Dreaming - session start gate
hooks.description: If the dual gate is met (>= min_hours AND >= min_sessions since the last dream), nudge the user to run /dream. Never blocks.

action.command: R='${WORKSPACE_ROOT}'; S="$R/.assert-iq/dreaming/scripts/dream-gate.sh"; [ -f "$S" ] || { R='__PACK_ROOT__'; S="$R/.assert-iq/dreaming/scripts/dream-gate.sh"; }; [ -f "$S" ] || exit 0; AIQ_PACK_ROOT="$R" AIQ_HOOK_OUTPUT=plain bash "$S"

hooks.name: Assert.IQ Dreaming - record session
hooks.description: Increment the session counter and append a line to the daily memory log when a turn ends.

action.command: R='${WORKSPACE_ROOT}'; S="$R/.assert-iq/dreaming/scripts/dream-record-session.sh"; [ -f "$S" ] || { R='__PACK_ROOT__'; S="$R/.assert-iq/dreaming/scripts/dream-record-session.sh"; }; [ -f "$S" ] || exit 0; AIQ_PACK_ROOT="$R" AIQ_HOOK_OUTPUT=plain bash "$S"
